description: A 20,000-row national NGO ledger split between field expenses and salary registers, with messy codes, status text, subtotal rows, and a lookup join.

questions.question: What is the combined eligible field-expense and salary total in INR? Normalize cost-centre codes by trimming spaces and matching case-insensitively to the Cost Centre Lookup; exclude codes absent from the lookup. Include only Posted field expenses and Paid salary lines, matching statuses after trimming spaces and ignoring case.
questions.trap: Summing batch subtotals or including draft, void, held, reversed, or unmapped lines.

questions.question: What is the combined eligible amount for Maternal and Child Health in Odisha? Normalize cost-centre codes by trimming spaces and matching case-insensitively to the Cost Centre Lookup; exclude codes absent from the lookup. Include only Posted field expenses and Paid salary lines, matching statuses after trimming spaces and ignoring case.
questions.trap: Filtering programme names without first joining cost-centre codes.

questions.question: How many eligible transaction lines map to Barmer district across both registers? Count field and payroll lines, not employees. Normalize cost-centre codes by trimming spaces and matching case-insensitively to the Cost Centre Lookup; exclude codes absent from the lookup. Include only Posted field expenses and Paid salary lines, matching statuses after trimming spaces and ignoring case.
questions.trap: Counting distinct employees or including subtotal rows.

questions.question: Which programme has the highest combined eligible amount across both registers? Include only Posted field expenses and Paid salary lines, matching statuses after trimming spaces and ignoring case.
questions.trap: Ranking raw cost-centre codes instead of programmes from the lookup.

questions.question: For Rural Livelihoods, what percentage of its combined eligible amount comes from the salary register? Return a percentage from 0 to 100. Include only Posted field expenses and Paid salary lines, matching statuses after trimming spaces and ignoring case.

questions.question: Which district has the highest combined eligible amount across both registers?
